name: Stablecoin and digital-money job map 2026: five job families, four levels
description: A job architecture for stablecoin issuers, banks and corporates: five job families (compliance, risk and regulatory affairs; custody and key security; issuance, reserves and treasury; tokenisation and product; corporate digital treasury), four levels each from specialist to executive, example titles in English and Spanish, and the field most hires come from.
author: Borja Burguillos
